rows.title: KB-101 — Discount Authority Policy
rows.body: Quotes may carry at most 15% discount without Deal Desk approval, and never more than 20% in an Approved state under any authority. Any Approved quote above 20% is out of policy.

rows.title: KB-102 — Regulated Product Approval Chain
rows.body: Quotes containing regulated products require the Compliance step recorded before approval.

rows.title: KB-103 — Payment Terms Standard
rows.body: Net-30 is standard; anything longer than Net-60 requires Finance sign-off.

rows.title: KB-104 — Promotional Discount Windows
rows.body: During declared promotional windows, list prices may be reduced at the catalog level. This policy does not change quote discount ceilings (see KB-101).
